workflows.source:
name: check

on:
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
    types: [checks_requested]
  push:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check out source
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Use Node.js 24
        uses: actions/setup-node@820762786026740c76f36085b0efc47a31fe5020 # v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run complete quality gate
        run: npm run check

      - name: Verify committed Action bundle
        run: git diff --exit-code -- dist/action/index.js

  compatibility:
    name: Node.js 22 compatibility
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check out source
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Use Node.js 22
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run complete quality gate on Node.js 22
        run: npm run check
